detailed_description: The HMAC Generator is a cryptographic utility that produces Hash-based Message Authentication Codes (HMACs) using industry-standard algorithms: SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512. HMACs combine symmetric key cryptography with hash functions to verify both data integrity and authenticity. This tool implements RFC 2104 specifications, enabling developers to generate message authentication codes that ensure transmitted data hasn't been altered without access to the original secret key. Developers require this tool for secure API communication (e.g., signing OAuth requests), validating webhook payloads in web services, and protecting configuration files. The generator processes input text through the selected algorithm with a user-provided key, applying inner and outer padding (ipad/opad) as defined in HMAC construction. Results are displayed in hexadecimal or Base64 encoding, with options to copy raw values for immediate implementation in codebases.
usage_steps: Enter plain text data into the 'Message' text area requiring HMAC generation
Input a cryptographic secret key in the designated field (supports ASCII and hex-encoded keys)
Select hashing algorithm from dropdown: SHA-1 (160-bit), SHA-256 (256-bit), or SHA-512 (512-bit)
Choose output format: Hexadecimal (default) or Base64 for API-specific requirements
Click 'Generate HMAC' to execute the two-pass hashing process
Copy resulting HMAC value from the output box for integration into authentication headers or verification systems
usage_examples: Securing REST API endpoints by generating request signatures validated remote with matching secret keys
Verifying GitHub webhook payloads by comparing generated HMAC-SHA256 against X-Hub-Signature-256 headers
Creating time-limited password reset tokens using HMAC-SHA512 with user-specific salts
Validating firmware update packages through HMAC integrity checks before device-side execution
